name: pi-context-engineer
description: Keeps large Pi and Fabric tool results out of model context: offloads them to a local store behind a readable handle, compacts oversized errors and edit diffs, and records what it saved.
author: pyan

scripts.build: rm -rf .tmp/pi-ce-build && tsc --outDir .tmp/pi-ce-build --rootDir src --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck src/*.ts
scripts.verify: npm run build && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-hooks.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-runtime.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-fabric-child.js && node .tmp/pi-ce-build/verify-remediation.js
